reader.requirement: The first time a program is called in a run unit (contained or separately compiled, by literal or identifier) it must be in its initial state (X.2.4.1): Working-Storage items with VALUE hold their values (every class: numeric display and COMP, edited, group, ALL literal, figurative constants, condition-names true per VALUE), its internal files are not open, PERFORM control is initial and every ALTERed GO TO goes to its written target.

edition-consulted.switches: ALTER accepted at 85, refused from 2002 (REMOVED); the 1985 arm accepts the form whose initial state GR1 governs

reader.edition-search: ProgramTable.cs has no Edition reference on the activation path; BinderDriver sets UnitStaticWs = unit.Recursive && !unit.Initial with no edition test (RECURSIVE does not exist at 85, so every 85 program takes the cached-instance arm the latest edition takes for a non-recursive program)
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only in which forms exist; the ALTERed GO TO initial state is a 1985 form (ALTER is refused at 2023), the rest of the initial state is the same path
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f02_02 covers WS VALUE initialization on the first call; not exercised there: COMP, edited, ALL, figurative and condition-name values, the internal file not open (47 on READ), the ALTERed GO TO's written target, and a CALL by identifier of a separately compiled program

probes.printed: SUB FIRST-TIME / SUB CNT=1 CMP=-0012 ED= 12.50 GRP=ABCD ALLX=**** ZER=000 SP=[   ] / SUB READ-NOT-OPEN 47 / SUB OPEN 00 / SUB SA1 / SUB CNT=2 CMP=+0077 ... GRP=WXYZ ALLX=---- / SUB READ-NOT-OPEN 47 / SUB OPEN 41 / SUB SA2
probes.expected: first call: VALUEs in place, 88 true, file not open (READ 47, OPEN 00), GO TO to its written target SA1; second call (not initial) keeps the changed values, the open file (41) and the ALTER (SA2)

probes.printed: NON CNT=101 TXT=FRESH / NON CNT=102 TXT=USED  / INI CNT=101 TXT=FRESH / INI CNT=101 TXT=FRESH
probes.expected: separately compiled program called by identifier: initial on the first call, last-used on the second

probes.printed: error COBOL0810: the ALTER statement was removed in COBOL-2002
probes.expected: ALTER is not 2023 syntax; the ALTER part of the initial state is the 1985 edition's own

citations.check: OK  §1985:X.2.4.2 GR1  (2.4.2 Programs in the Initial State)  the text is in GR1
OK  §1985:X.2.4.1 GR1  (2.4.1 Characteristics of a Program)  the text is in GR1
OK  §1985:X.2.4.1  (2.4.1 Characteristics of a Program)  the text is in the clause; it lies in GR2
OK  §1985:X.2.4.1 GR4  (2.4.1 Characteristics of a Program)  the text is in GR4

reader.notes: A non-initial program's instance is created on its first CALL (ProgramTable.CallProgram, n.Instance ??= Create) and its WS, connectors and ALTER switches are instance fields initialized by the emitted initial-state code, so the first call is the initial state. PERFORM control on a first call is trivially initial and not separately observable; the Communication Section was not probed.

refuter.evidence: Probe r5ini.cob at --std 85 (runs/r5ini-001): X.2.4.1 GR2 limits not-open to INTERNAL connectors; an EXTERNAL file opened by the main program is open at the first call of R5SUB (WRITE 00, record SUB1 in R5EF.DAT), as it must be. r6val.cob (runs/r6val-002) initial values on first call of scaled P (9PP=300, SVPP9=-.004), SIGN LEADING SEPARATE, SIGN TRAILING, 9V99, QUOTES, HIGH-VALUE, group of display/COMP, 88 with THRU all in place. ProgramTable.CallProgram creates the instance on first CALL with no edition consult. cites: OK  §1985:X.2.4.2 GR1  (2.4.2 Programs in the Initial State)  the text is in GR1; OK  §1985:X.2.4.1 GR2  (2.4.1 Characteristics of a Program)  the text is in GR2.
